motivation: Test whether loss of focal Thalassia state is buffered by occupancy of other seagrasses, separating foundation-species turnover from loss of seagrass habitat occupancy.

source.stable_point_id: Point-event locationID, constructed upstream as Transect + Site/meter-mark identity
source.seagrass_definition: Any occurrenceStatus=present taxon in order Alismatales. This includes Thalassia and other seagrasses represented by the pinned source rather than only the four species in the prior community analysis.

H1_transect_occupancy_buffering.statement: Within Lower Tampa Bay, Thalassia point frequency declines while non-Thalassia-only point occupancy increases, so any-seagrass point occupancy declines less than focal Thalassia occupancy.
H1_transect_occupancy_buffering.model: same within-node year-slope design as existing community analysis: node-centered year + cyclic survey date + log sampled-point effort; node-cluster bootstrap
support_rule: Thalassia frequency slope bootstrap 95% interval entirely below zero
non-Thalassia-only frequency slope bootstrap 95% interval entirely above zero
absolute any-seagrass frequency slope is smaller than absolute Thalassia frequency slope

H2_exact_point_turnover.statement: Among exact stable meter marks that lose Thalassia between consecutive post-2016 years, Lower Tampa Bay has a higher probability of remaining occupied by another seagrass than Old and Middle Tampa Bay combined.
H2_exact_point_turnover.eligible_transition: same stable point locationID observed in consecutive years; source year Thalassia present; target year Thalassia absent
H2_exact_point_turnover.endpoint: target point has any non-Thalassia seagrass present versus no seagrass present
H2_exact_point_turnover.estimator: node-cluster bootstrap difference in replacement fraction: Lower minus Old+Middle
H2_exact_point_turnover.support_rule: bootstrap 95% interval for Lower-minus-comparison replacement fraction entirely above zero

sensitivity.H2_species_fates: Report target alternative-seagrass identity frequencies for Halodule wrightii, Syringodium filiforme, Ruppia maritima, Halophila spp./taxa if present; descriptive only.
sensitivity.other_segments: Report all bay segments descriptively but do not promote another segment if Lower primary fails.

claim_boundary: Post-hoc ecological hypothesis motivated by already-opened community trajectories.
Any-seagrass occupancy is a habitat-state metric, not a measure of equivalent ecosystem function among species.
Alternative occupancy after Thalassia loss is species turnover/reorganization, not proof of competition or causal replacement.
Stable meter-mark identity is taken from the pinned source's point locationID construction and must pass repeated-point coverage checks.
Do not change the primary segment, period, point-loss definition, comparison group, bootstrap rule, or seagrass taxonomic definition after opening the endpoint result.

implementation_freeze.point_year_state: For each stable point locationID x calendar year, classify each visit as focal_present (Thalassia present, regardless of co-occurring seagrass), other_only (Thalassia absent and >=1 other present Alismatales taxon), or bare (no present Alismatales). Retain the point-year for H2 only when all repeated visits in that year agree on the same class; otherwise mark ambiguous and exclude.
implementation_freeze.H2_group_bootstrap: Resample stable transect nodes with replacement separately within Lower Tampa Bay and the pooled Old+Middle comparison; all eligible point-loss transitions from each sampled node travel together.
